entities.summary: Paul Kaba Thieba (b. 1960-07-28, Bobo-Dioulasso) was a military leader or commander of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Bobo-Dioulasso and Burkina Faso. Known in the fields of burkina faso, merchants & economists, africa.
